reason: Original IR point mode only filters RGB corners by an IR mask. A textureless RGB fish can therefore have no semantic contour anchors even when actual generated IR has a useful boundary.
data: Unchanged actual November DiffV2IR, RGB pixels, frozen original two detector streams and Dev split. No image regeneration, GT-driven proposal or encoder training.
native_corners: For the additional joint-body packet, use native IR corner response under the original RGB/IR joint ownership mask when original IR quality>=0.15. Otherwise retain the original RGB point packet. Same corner suppression, spacing and point budget. Original bbox/RGB/IR/joint packets are retained unchanged as controls.

variants.rgb: Original RGB-body corners and original RGB flow
variants.bbox: Original unmasked RGB corners and original RGB flow
variants.original_joint: Original RGB corners selected under joint masks, original RGB flow
variants.semantic_rgb: Actual IR contour corners, original RGB flow
variants.semantic_safe: Same actual IR contour corners, preserve every valid RGB point flow; use FB-checked IR flow only where RGB flow fails
variants.semantic_ir: Same actual IR contour corners, native IR flow as a removal/diagnostic control

consistency: Same original forward/backward threshold1.5 pixels, photometric error40, per-body robust movement check and conserved target ownership with background mass0.25. No new threshold fitting.
diagnostic: Sample the declared source grid across both full Dev videos, retain all original candidate hypotheses, finish both unlabeled producers before reading any Dev annotation. Report per-lag edge AUC, top1 recall, missing-target false acceptance and low-RGB-support behavior. This sparse mechanism diagnosis is not full tracking HOTA.
RGB_control: Same point budget and original source proposals. Original RGB packets and base/reference features remain unchanged. Extra RGB capacity and mask-only controls remain mandatory before any claimed improvement.
Test_policy: No Test is read or fitted in this diagnosis. A positive diagnosis must still receive Train-only fitting and full Dev/Test tracking validation.
